content.text: CI changes go without a changelog entry. Validating YAML, then committing.

ops:
HUB_WORKSPACE && python3 -c "import yaml;yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml'))" && git commit -qam "ci: upgrade pi-action to v2.3.0, pit to v0.35.1, and trust the project's functions

Refs #358" && git push -q -u origin ci/upg
